Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: finished hand-crafted pixel-art walking animation SOURCE ROW, ONE horizontal row of exactly FOUR full-body Mara poses on genuinely transparent alpha. Input image 1 = approved CANONICAL character identity, style and camera reference. Input image 2 = existing Adventure character sheet, supplementary identity ONLY, do not copy its eye-level camera or multiple rows. Same young slender woman as canonical approved reference: dark brown angular bob hair, burgundy/wine-red open short jacket, light cream blouse, dark teal trousers, brown ankle boots. Preserve canonical face, hair mass, palette and proportions; no hat or accessories.
CAMERA: Preserve the approved elevated, slightly oblique RPG top-down camera of input 1, approximately 55-60 degrees above ground; visible head crown, foreshortened torso. NOT new extreme vertical overhead and NOT pure eye-level side-view. ALL FOUR POSES face and walk toward IMAGE RIGHT. True rightward body anatomy and feet; see rightward facial profile and upper hair/head surfaces, NOT a frontal body turned at the neck, no left-facing poses.
FOUR DISTINCT consecutive animation drawings LEFT TO RIGHT: (0) contact with anatomical right leg advanced and left leg trailing, left arm advanced opposite right leg; a restrained contact pose also suitable as standing frame. (1) first passing: right foot supports under body, left knee/foot swinging through toward the next step; opposed arms in transition. (2) opposite contact: left leg advanced, right leg trailing, right arm advanced opposite left leg; clearly distinguish from pose0. (3) second passing: left foot supports under body, right knee/foot swings through; opposite arm phase to pose1. Natural modest walking stride. Maintain same identity, body volume, camera, scale, head shape and body height across all four; no hopping/squatting, no changing clothes. Legs and opposing arms must visibly alternate, not four copies.
LAYOUT: wide approximately 3:1 canvas. Exactly four equally spaced, isolated complete figures in a SINGLE ROW, centered at 12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5% of canvas width. Common ground-contact baseline near 92% canvas height, tops near 12%; keep clear transparent gaps between figures and margin around every complete silhouette, including hands, hair and soles. No overlap and nothing cut off at image edges. Each pose will be cropped and proportionally reduced to 120 visible pixels tall in a 128x128 game cell, then shown in 32px target frames; readable solid color clusters and clear 4-phase silhouettes are essential.
RENDER: crisp developed pixel art matching input1, deliberate hard-edged pixel clusters, consistent discreet upper-left lighting, no soft painting or smooth gradients. Opaque SOLID interiors and clean hard alpha edges on a truly transparent canvas. No semitransparent haze, ground/cast shadows, matte, light fringes, blur, bloom, grain, motion trails, prop, floor, backdrop, black/white/checkerboard background, text, numbers, gridlines, borders, labels, caption, watermark. Do not reproduce the input references elsewhere in output. Generate these four new poses, do not rotate/stretch the old image.
